records.title: Postexercise Death Due to Hemorrhagic Colloid Cyst of Third Ventricle: Case Report and Literature Review.
records.authors: Cuoco JA, Rogers CM, Busch CM, Benko MJ, Apfel LS, Elias Z
records.query: colloid cyst third ventricle origin theories
records.excerpt: Colloid cysts of the third ventricle are rare, slow-growing lesions of neuroepithelial origin. Although histopathologically benign, third ventricular colloid cysts are a well-known cause of sudden, unexpected coma and death.
records.note: Clinical colloid cyst case report/review (fatal haemorrhagic cyst); asserts neuroepithelial origin but contains no paraphysis data in the abstract.
